tasks.title: Extend Order model with FILLED status, remainingAmount, and embedded FillEvent
tasks.dod: Order/OrderStatus/FillEvent compile with the new fields and existing OrderServiceTest still passes unmodified.

tasks.title: Add MongoTemplate-based atomic conditional update helpers for cancel/fill/amend
tasks.dod: A unit test against each of the three guarded update methods (cancel/fill/amend) shows the write applies only when its precondition holds and returns no-match otherwise.

tasks.title: Implement guarded cancelOrder, fillOrder, and amendOrder in OrderService
tasks.dod: Unit tests (mocked repository, extending OrderServiceTest's existing style) cover the happy path and every rejection reason for cancel, fill, and amend, including the AC-11 legacy-order fallback.

tasks.title: Add fill/amend endpoints and extend cancel + exception handling in OrderController
tasks.dod: A controller-layer test (MockMvc or equivalent) confirms POST /api/orders/{id}/fills and PATCH /api/orders/{id} return the spec'd status codes and ApiError.code for every AC-04/AC-10/AC-12 rejection, and DELETE keeps working for AC-01/AC-02.

tasks.title: Add an integration-test harness (ephemeral MongoDB) for the backend
tasks.dod: A trivial integration test boots the ephemeral MongoDB, saves and reads back an Order through the real OrderRepository, and passes in mvn test.

tasks.title: Write concurrency integration tests for overfill and cross-action races
tasks.dod: An integration test firing two concurrent fills, and a fill racing a cancel, against the same order asserts exactly one action succeeds and the order's remaining amount is never negative or inconsistent.

tasks.title: Introduce react-router and split App.tsx into two routed page shells
tasks.dod: Navigating to / renders OrderEntryPage and /manage-orders renders ManageOrdersPage, each at its own URL, with a working nav link between them; npm run build passes.

tasks.title: Extend the API client and TS types for fill/amend/remainingAmount/FillEvent
tasks.dod: orderApi.ts exposes fillOrder(id, amount) and amendOrder(id, {price?, remainingAmount?}) typed against the extended Order/FillEvent types, and tsc -b passes.

tasks.title: Make the order entry page creation-only
tasks.dod: OrderEntryPage renders only the creation form (no order list, no Cancel action) and shows an inline success confirmation on create.

tasks.title: Build the Manage Orders list screen with status-gated actions
tasks.dod: ManageOrdersPage lists every order regardless of status via GET /api/orders, with Cancel/Fill/Amend buttons enabled only on PENDING rows and disabled on CANCELLED/FILLED rows, plus loading/empty/error states.

tasks.title: Build the Cancel and Cancel-with-forfeiture dialogs
tasks.dod: Cancel on a fill-free order shows the simple confirm dialog (AC-01); Cancel on an order with fills shows the forfeiture dialog naming the amount that will be lost and requires a second confirmation (AC-02); both disable their buttons while the request is in flight.

tasks.title: Build the Fill entry dialog
tasks.dod: Submitting a valid fill amount records it and closes the dialog (AC-03); a zero/negative/overfilling amount, or a losing race (AC-05), shows an inline rejection naming the reason without closing the dialog (AC-04); the submit button is disabled while the request is in flight.

tasks.title: Build the Amend entry dialog
tasks.dod: Submitting a valid price/remaining-amount amend updates the order and closes the dialog with the new values confirmed (AC-06, AC-07); a remaining amount above (amount - filled) or exactly zero is rejected inline with the allowed range shown (AC-12).

tasks.title: Build the expandable fill trail row
tasks.dod: Expanding a row with one or more fill events shows each fill's amount and timestamp, oldest first, with no separate network request; collapsing hides it again.

tasks.title: Add a frontend test runner and e2e-through-UI tests for every action
tasks.dod: A test runner (e.g. Vitest + Testing Library) is wired into npm test, and one e2e-through-UI test per action (cancel/fill/amend/view-trail/entry-page-creation-only/navigation) exercises the UI against a running or mocked API and passes.
